culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Nenji Norimura. He is the only one who could've committed the murder since the culprit was a ranked swordsman who deliberately put the skirt backwards to make people think it was someone who didn't know kendo and it matched Norimura's description. As Heiji explains his deduction, Kazuha and the Osaka school's team try to find Heiji so she tries to call Ran so they can return before the match begins but Ran skips the call.

motive.zhHans: 他是唯一有可能犯下这起谋杀的人，因为凶手是有段位的剑道选手，故意把裙甲反过来穿，让人以为是不懂剑道的人所为，而这正符合 Norimura 的特征。实际上，“cutter”这个词是关西腔，意思是衬衫。真相揭晓：Nukitani 正在和妻子通电话，让她再送一件衬衫过来，因为他那件已经染血了——因为在先前 Okita 参加的一场比赛中，对手把 Nukitani 推得太用力，导致他流了鼻血。服部平次（Heiji）取笑江户川柯南（Conan），因为破案的人是他。Norimura 使用竹刀，是因为他想用儿子的刀为儿子复仇。结果他被取消资格，输掉了比赛。他深感内疚，觉得自己仅仅因为一个小小的失误就让整所学校失望了。尽管心烦意乱，他起初认为那起自杀没有什么可怨恨裁判 Nukitani 的，但是，在比赛中，他看到 Nukitani 无视了东都身心高中（Tohto Senshin High School）一名学生做出的胜利姿势。他随后上前与他交谈，发现他因为两人都来自关西而有所偏袒，这让他产生了杀死 Nukitani 的念头。
motive.en: He is the only one who could've committed the murder since the culprit was a ranked swordsman who deliberately put the skirt backwards to make people think it was someone who didn't know kendo and it matched Norimura's description. In fact, the word "cutter" was in Kansai Dialect and it meant a dress shirt, it is revealed that Nukitani was talking to his wife on the phone and asking her to bring him another dress shirt since his' was bloody because, in a previous match where Okita was participating, his opponent pushed Nukitani so hard his nose bled. Heiji laughs at Conan since he was the one who solved it. Norimura used a bamboo sword because he wanted to use his son's sword to avenge him. As a result he was disqualified and lost the match, he felt such guilt because he had felt like he had let his entire school down all because of one simple mistake. Although distraught, He first thought that his suicide was not anything to have a grudge against the referee, Nukitani, but, In the tournament, he saw that Nukitani ignored the victory pose done by a student of Tohto Senshin High School. He then went to talk with him and he had showed favoritism since they were both from Kansai which made him want to kill Nukitani.

Norimura used a bamboo sword because he wanted to use his son's sword to avenge him.

evidence.zhHans: 实际上，“cutter”这个词是关西腔，意思是衬衫。真相揭晓：Nukitani 正在和妻子通电话，让她再送一件衬衫过来，因为他那件已经染血了——因为在先前 Okita 参加的一场比赛中，对手把 Nukitani 推得太用力，导致他流了鼻血。凶器其实是他的竹刀。他取一节竹子，将其削尖，做成一件锋利的武器，然后水平挥动，利用离心力割开他人的喉咙。人们在洗手间听到的声音，其实是 Norimura 在墙上把刀尖磨钝，这意味着证据（血迹）很容易被发现卡在他刀袋的内侧。
evidence.en: In fact, the word "cutter" was in Kansai Dialect and it meant a dress shirt, it is revealed that Nukitani was talking to his wife on the phone and asking her to bring him another dress shirt since his' was bloody because, in a previous match where Okita was participating, his opponent pushed Nukitani so hard his nose bled. The weapon was in fact his bamboo sword in which he used to make a sharp weapon by taking a single piece of bamboo and sharpened it and then swung it horizontally so the centrifugal force could cut someone's throat. The sound people heard in the bathroom was in fact Norimura dulling the tip against the wall which meant that the proof (blood) will be easily found stuck in the inside of his sword bag.
